A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Asparagus & Rice** (≈30 min).  
- Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, paprika.  
- Sear skin-side down 5 min, flip, add minced garlic, lemon slices, asparagus.  
- Pour in ½ cup chicken broth + 1 tbsp butter, simmer 10 min covered.  
- Serve over 90-sec microwave rice; drizzle pan sauce.

PLAN: Ask if they want the full written recipe with measurements.  
PLAN: Offer a vegetarian swap (tofu + same pan method).  
PLAN: Suggest 2 make-ahead tips (pre-chop veg, marinate chicken morning).
